<thought>Based on the six measured resistances between the four nodes, a simple series chain of three resistors fits all data:
- R1 = 10 Ω between X1 and N_b1 (matches X1‑N_b1 measurement)
- R2 = 15 Ω between N_b1 and N_b2 (matches N_b1‑N_b2 measurement)
- R3 = 20 Ω between N_b2 and X2 (matches N_b2‑X2 measurement)

All other pairwise resistances are sums of the appropriate series segments, matching the given values. Hence the subnetwork topology is a straight series connection.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 10, "R2": 15, "R3": 20}, "connections": [["X1", "N_b1", "R1"], ["N_b1", "N_b2", "R2"], ["N_b2", "X2", "R3"]]}</final_answer>
